baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form II active participle مُكَذِّبِينَ in وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The participle names agents of attribution: they do not merely utter falsehood but class a report, event, or bearer as false. The focus construction then assigns woe to those prior judges on the indicated day.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the participle's active attribution and the model's reversed judgment.

changed_reading.before: Woe that day to liars or disbelievers in a broad static sense.
changed_reading.after: Woe that day to those who actively pronounced the report, event, or bearer false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُكَذِّبِينَ together with the result-pointing يَوْمَئِذٍ in 77:45.
baseline_models.mechanism: A peripheral root image makes truth or falsity visible in whether a charge is carried through. The deictic day can therefore be heard as the outcome that tests the deniers' earlier verdict rather than merely the date of punishment.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true by being carried through, or false by failing, supplies an outcome-sensitive test for denial.

changed_reading.before: Their denial is a settled opinion whose consequence arrives later.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is a verdict put under an outcome test on 'that day,' when what does or does not carry through becomes manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement sends, spreads, distinguishes, casts a reminder, and awakens warning; the threatened appointment then falls and becomes fixed. This turns active falsification into an attempted break between a delivered warning and its eventual material occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to a report supplies the focus act that resists the chain.
Dispatch and setting-out supply the chain's originating movement.
Opening, spreading, and branching make the dispatched content publicly extended.
Distinguishing two things gives the spread message a truth-separating function.
Casting something until it lies before a recipient supplies the delivery step.
A reminder that makes one remember identifies what is being delivered.
Warning that frightens and wakes caution gives the reminder prospective force.
Threat and warning specify the adverse content announced to the deniers.
Falling and becoming fixed convert announcement into realized event.

structural_cues: 77:1-7 moves through a rapid participial series and culminates in the finite assertion that what is promised will occur.
The recurring focus formula later answers that opening assertion after successive scenes of realization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered movements and the promise's occurrence; I supply the causal pipeline from dispatch to realization. A live alternative is that 77:1-6 offers parallel oath images rather than successive stages.

changed_reading.before: The deniers simply reject a warning.
changed_reading.after: The deniers try to sever a warning from the ordered process by which it is sent, disclosed, distinguished, delivered, and finally made actual.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed limit convenes a severe day on which scattered parties are gathered and truth is judicially separated from falsehood. The repeated woe formula consequently works as a recurring verdict, and at 77:45 it seals the favorable judgment on the doers of good by naming the opposite class.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the class against whom the verdict is issued.
Fixing a thing by a time or limit supplies the proceeding's scheduled boundary.
The day's event and severity make يَوْمَئِذٍ an operative crisis rather than a bare date.
A prescribed terminal time supplies the deadline at which deferral ends.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the refrain's adjudicative mechanism.
The same active-falsifier category recurring before the focus makes the judgment serial rather than isolated.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the joint appearance required before separation.

structural_cues: The exact refrain occurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49, repeatedly closing or turning scenes.
77:45 stands immediately after 77:41-44's protected reward and immediately before 77:46's brief criminal enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, gathering, separation, and exact recurrence; I infer that each recurrence acts as a sectional verdict or seal. It may instead be primarily refrain-like intensification without a strict docket structure.

changed_reading.before: 77:45 is another isolated curse inserted after the reward scene.
changed_reading.after: 77:45 is a repeated judicial ruling at the appointed separation, here drawing the class boundary after the doers of good have been recompensed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is presented as measure placed in a stable, capable location until a bounded term; the earth then gathers and the mountains anchor. The recurring accusation of denial therefore concerns refusal to let ordered material processes count as evidence, not only rejection of a verbal proposition.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false anchors the focus category and is recast as rejection of demonstrative order.
Measuring and proportioning supply the first material operation.
Fixity and stable settlement supply the receptacle's holding function.
Capability and enablement make the stable location functionally adequate.
An amount reaching its bounded limit supplies calibrated duration and extent.
Gathering and gripping within a container extends the holding mechanism from womb to earth.
Firm anchoring gives the earth sequence a visible stabilizing operation.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 and 77:25-27 form two compact material demonstrations, each followed by the refrain at 77:24 or 77:28.
The focus ayah repeats that same verdict after later demonstrations of differentiated outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated containment and stabilization plus refrain placement; I infer that these scenes function evidentially and that denying means refusing their inference. They could instead be read chiefly as displays of power or beneficence.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject an externally announced claim.
changed_reading.after: The deniers also refuse measured containment, bounded development, and terrestrial stability permission to testify to the announced outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same command to eat opens two opposed economies. Before 77:45, eating is pleasant recompense tied to intentional work and goodness; after it, eating is joined to enjoyment of slight duration and criminality. The focus refrain is the hinge that denies the apparent equivalence of the two consumptions.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies a mechanism of wrongly classifying two outwardly similar meals as equivalent.
Offense and culpable injury mark the moral basis of the post-focus consumption.
Literal eating supplies the repeated surface action shared by the two addresses.
Intentional action supplies the basis attached to the first meal.
Answering an act with its recompense defines the first meal as outcome rather than indulgence.
Doing what is good identifies the class receiving the first recompense.
Pleasurable benefit defines the second meal by present use rather than recompense.
Smallness and paucity sharply limit the second meal's horizon.

structural_cues: 77:43 كُلُوا واشربوا هنيئا is answered across 77:45 by 77:46 كُلُوا وتمتعوا قليلا.
The first command is grounded in what its addressees worked and divine recompense; the second ends by naming its addressees criminals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the echoed imperative and opposite qualifications; I infer that 77:45 functions as the classificatory hinge and that denial collapses the difference. The two commands could remain separate addresses without this mirror doing semantic work.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are a generic group mentioned between a reward scene and a warning.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are those who falsely equate present consumption with recompensed consumption, ignoring that identical eating can have opposite basis, duration, and end.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus-root image of provision disappearing instead of lasting is activated by enjoyment whose extension is explicitly slight and whose criminal label carries a peripheral image of time reaching its cutoff. Denial can thus be lived as the false expectation that present pleasure will continue to yield.

activation_trace.role: Milk disappearing rather than lasting as expected supplies the focus-root image of failed persistence.
A span reaching completion and being cut off gives the criminal address an exploratory terminal edge.
Something kept extended for enjoyment supplies the duration that the next word restricts.
Paucity makes that pleasurable extension too slight to sustain the expectation placed on it.

structural_cues: The focus refrain is followed immediately by an imperative to enjoy only قليلا.
That short enjoyment contrasts with the unqualified pleasant recompense of 77:43-44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed-duration, extension, slightness, and cutoff images; I infer that the denier's stance includes an expectation that present provision will keep yielding. The live alternative is that قليلا only limits time and does not characterize denial itself.

changed_reading.before: Denial is chiefly a proposition about whether the warning is true.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also enacted by trusting a present pleasure to keep giving, until its short duration exposes that expectation as false.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from denial as speech to the loss of speech and excuse, then shows a spoken command answered by refusal to bow, and ends by asking what later discourse could settle the heart. The focus participle consequently names a coordinated refusal across assertion, answerability, bodily submission, and trust.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the message false anchors the initial speech act that expands into embodied refusal.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defensive speech no longer available.
Speech itself supplies the capacity suspended on the day of judgment.
Permission to act supplies the procedural gate that remains closed to excuse.
An uttered command supplies the proposition to which conduct must answer.
Humility and self-lowering supply the bodily response explicitly withheld.
Discourse renewed as news supplies the hypothetical later message that could follow.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the trust no subsequent discourse is expected to produce.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech and excuse before the refrain at 77:37.
77:48's refusal to bow is bracketed by refrains at 77:47 and 77:49, followed by the final question about believing another discourse at 77:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked speech, refused posture, and failed later belief; I infer that these are phases of one denial mechanism. They may instead belong to distinct scenes whose linkage is rhetorical rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: The mukadhdhibun are people holding or voicing a false judgment.
changed_reading.after: The mukadhdhibun enact denial by refusing the commanded posture and the heart-settling force of discourse, until even defensive speech is unavailable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a dyed-cloth idiom from the focus root into the surah's two kinds of shade; it remains anchored in ك ذ ب and in the explicit contrast between shade that cannot protect and protective shades. Render it only as a material analogy for deceptive appearance, not as a lexical translation of مُكَذِّبِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُكَذِّبِينَ activated through the branch in which a cloth 'lies' by its variegated appearance.

activation_trace.role: A cloth whose appearance deceives supplies the focus-root analogy of a visible state making a false claim.
Shade as covering supplies the apparent shelter offered to the deniers.
Sufficiency supplies the protective function explicitly denied to that apparent shade.
Shelter and defense supply the function realized by the contrasting shades of the protected.
Repelling harm by protection confirms the functional shelter on the reward side.

changed_reading.after: Deniers may also inhabit or endorse an appearance that claims to shelter while its state cannot perform shelter, unlike the protection immediately preceding 77:45.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the campaign sense of ك ذ ب and the combat edge of كيد, both distant from the ordinary participle. It remains anchored in the focus root and in 77:39's direct challenge to produce a counter-plan before the repeated verdict. Render it as a tactical analogy whose failure displays falsity, not as the base meaning of denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُكَذِّبِينَ through the branch where a charge proves true only by being carried through.

activation_trace.role: A charge becoming false when it fails supplies the outcome test for the deniers' counter-position.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the arena in which the countercharge is tested.
Plotting and stratagem supply the challenged counter-plan.
War and combat sharpen that plan into a counter-campaign whose inability to carry through exposes it.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an opinion that receives punishment.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a challenged counter-campaign: it is invited to carry through at the day of separation and proves false by failing.

strongest_changes: The recurring formula became a serial verdict at the appointed gathering and separation, with 77:45 sealing the reward scene.
The matched eating commands on either side of 77:45 made denial a false equivalence between recompensed consumption and brief criminal enjoyment.
The ending expanded denial from assertion into refused posture, failed trust, and the eventual loss of permission to excuse.
The opening chain and material demonstrations made falsification resistance to a warning moving from delivery and evidence into realized event.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed the refrain's changing local work and let peripheral ك ذ ب images activate against duration, shelter, and failed counter-action without replacing the participle's primary attribution sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening participles may be parallel oath images rather than a strict transmission pipeline.
The failed-duration, deceptive-shelter, and countercharge readings are analogical branch activations, not lexical substitutions.
The mirrored eating commands strongly frame 77:45, but their two addresses need not form a single semantic mechanism.
